title: nixos/wstunnel: convert to RFC42-style settings
reason: Applicable: real wstunnel module + wired test (wstunnel = runTest ./wstunnel.nix; at head). Real diff is a large restructuring: extraArgs, websocketPingInterval, and the hostPortSubmodule pattern are all REMOVED from the shared commonOptions (used by both services.wstunnel.servers.<name> and .clients.<name> wildcard instances), replaced by a new argsFormat/RFC42-style settings approach -- a genuine multi-option lifecycle event across a wildcard-instance module, similar in shape to S4's own frp fixture.
targets_toml: single target wstunnel, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,wstunnel,clients,*] (wildcard attrsOf-submodule-instance form, same shape as S4's own frp fixture), watch=[extraArgs] (the removed option, chosen specifically to see how a real removal renders through the wildcard-instance pattern).

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: extraArgs genuinely existed at base (declared in commonOptions, merged into every services.wstunnel.clients.<name> instance) but resolves OptionNotFound there too -- NOT a new finding, this is CONSISTENT WITH the already-documented wildcard attrsOf(submodule) discovery gap (S4 final report item 17, previously confirmed recurring at #411705/#507312) -- flagging as a 3rd/4th-ish corroborating recurrence of that KNOWN gap, not a new candidate_capability_gap of its own.
